fragments.text: Sector M: installed 11 m of cable; testing stopped because the permit had expired.
Rebar installation was held because the crane broke down; 9 m3 concrete was placed in Bay K.
Yesterday three joints were delivered to compound H.
Today two spools for line 24-XX arrived at the laydown yard in Area A.
Cable laying was held for lack of access in Sector P; in Bay J, 4 m3 concrete was poured today.
